ops.title: prove-ci-follow: reconcile CI after a missing completion delivery
ops.description: Owner: prove-ci-follow change owner. HEAD 77dbcdf5bd98732dc8a361136b58b24c584a332a. Evidence: receiver.py:172-173 blocks until the ci mark changes; install.py:650-661 reads running once and then calls that unbounded wait. receiver.py:268 performs delivery catch-up only when the receiver starts. If the last completion delivery is lost, the run may be completed while the proof remains alive forever, and watch.py:1989-1990 will not start a replacement. Next executable step: add a finite event-wait reconciliation interval without adding an overall deadline for a genuinely running CI job; add a regression with unchanged marks and a subsequently completed API response. Review was code-only; no tests were run.

ops.text: A completed run is observed and the proof retries when its completion webhook never changes the ci mark; a genuinely running job can still outlive the proof timeout.
